QuestInfo.name: Jogging Your Memory
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2151000##k, the Warrior trainer in Edelstein, seems upset.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151000# thinks a stroll around Edelstein will help you regain your memories. Hunt #b50#k #b#o1150000##k monsters in #b#m310030000##k and retrieve #b15#k #b#t4000598##k items while you're at it.
QuestInfo.2: Your little stroll didn't bring back any memories, but #p2151000# says it's because Edelstein has changed so much. Interesting. You might want to think about that more, but for now, go talk to #bBrighton#k, the Battle Mage trainer. He's in the #bSecret Plaza#k.
